name: Legends Decoded
tagline: The mindset and decisions behind greatness — told by The Decoder.
about: Global English documentary channel on the mindset and decisions behind historical and contemporary figures. Brand: midnight navy and gold, Cinzel + Montserrat, narration voice 'The Decoder'. Launch slate: Gandhi, Ronaldo, Messi, JFK, Ali, Jobs, Mandela, Einstein, Bruce Lee, Kobe.
audience: Adults 18–45 in the UK, US and Europe (high RPM). Not made for kids.
visual_style: Cinematic documentary still, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, midnight navy and gold colour grade, film grain, 16:9, respectful portrayal, no text.
script_rules: Voice: The Decoder — calm, precise, intriguing. Structure: cold open hook (first 30 seconds) → the defining decision → early life that shaped it → turning points → the mindset decoded (3 principles) → legacy → one-line close. About 1,500–1,900 words for 10–12 minutes. Facts only; mark unsure claims (verify).
publish_rules: Title formulas that break out: 'The Untold Story of…', 'Inside [X]: The Most Powerful…', 'The Tragedy of…'. SEO anchor: success mindset. Thumbnail: subject portrait left; 2–3 line title with one gold word right; pillar tag (MINDSET / POWER / CHAMPION / VISIONARY); brand bug top corner. Not made for kids.

research.brief: Niche: mindset/biography documentaries. Look for figures with rising search interest, anniversaries in the next 4–6 weeks, and small-channel outliers. Prefer figures from the launch slate until it is done.

notes: Narration replaces the song. The timeline follows the script sections.
scene_len_note: Scene length in seconds. Match it to your clip tool: Grok/Vibes make ~6 s clips; Wan 3.0 can make any length.

packaging.title_pattern: "The Untold Story of <Name>" / "Inside <X>: The Most Powerful…" / "The Tragedy of <Name>" — name in the first 40 characters, no year tag unless it is news.
packaging.geo: USA, UK, Canada, Australia and India (English-speaking adults 18–44 interested in success stories and history).

thumb_rules: Subject portrait left; 2–3 line title right with one gold word; pillar tag (MINDSET / POWER / CHAMPION / VISIONARY); brand bug in a top corner; dark cinematic background with high contrast.
